buggy: pivot = max(range(col, size), key=lambda r: work[r][col])
fixed: pivot = max(range(col, size), key=lambda r: abs(work[r][col]))
summary: The pivot row is chosen by the largest signed value instead of the largest absolute value, so a column whose remaining entries are zero and negative picks the zero as pivot and the determinant is reported as 0, e.g. Matrix([[0, 1], [-2, 3]]).determinant() returns 0 instead of 2.
